subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram channel can be wedged by bad persisted session JSON; status should detect and offer recovery

question: Should bad Telegram/session-store JSON recovery stop at read-only status/doctor diagnostics first, or should OpenClaw also add an explicit backed-up reset/quarantine flow now?
rationale: The diagnostic gap is clear, but reset/quarantine behavior changes persisted session continuity and overlaps with the generic session-store recovery PR.

options.title: Diagnostics First
options.body: Add parse/read/size/schema warnings to status and doctor with backup guidance, then revisit reset semantics after #79910 lands.

options.title: Add Reset Command
options.body: Implement an explicit backup-and-reset/quarantine command now, accepting the larger product and migration surface.

options.title: Wait For Generic Recovery
options.body: Hold this issue until #79910 lands, then re-test whether Telegram-specific status guidance is still needed.

recommendation.title: Diagnostics First
recommendation.body: Add parse/read/size/schema warnings to status and doctor with backup guidance, then revisit reset semantics after #79910 lands.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans Telegram status UX and channel recovery behavior, both areas where steipete has recent relevant history.
